resolution.note: feat(review): size the review panel by the risk tier of the diff (t-sa7ag03)

title: review depth follows a risk tier of the diff
body:
Outcome: review depth follows risk, not a fixed panel. A deterministic classifier on the diff picks a tier: low (docs, tests, tracker, small non-sensitive code) = deterministic checks + one judge; medium = current panel; high (CI workflows, review/ship/deliver code, ADRs, spec/worker-scope.json) = panel + operator notice. The panel adds voting/dedup of findings, drops style findings and re-reviews only the diff after round one.
Evidence: .krn/runs/lead/market-research/report.md ("How the Claude Code team does code review", 2026-10-15: first-round pass 65%→78%, mean rounds 2.08→1.32); KRN review is the largest wait per slice.
Proof: classifier observer over fixture diffs per tier; panel observer asserting a duplicated finding is reported once and a style finding is dropped.
Decisions: a low tier without the full panel amends ADR 0014 D30 ("Standards and Spec required"); the lead decides it under the Full autonomy grant and records the amendment in the same PR.
Operator: "Możemy realnie w ogóle nie potrzebujemy tych wszystkich CI, PR-ów, gate'ów…" (2026-11-04).
